changeSet.createView: select `B`.`OS` AS `OS`,`A`.`APP_ID` AS `APP_ID`,count(0) AS `COUNT` from `TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN` `A` join `TB_ASMI_DEVICE_MASTER` `B` where ((`A`.`APP_ID` = `B`.`APP_ID`) and (`A`.`DEVICE_ID` = `B`.`DEVICE_ID`) and (`A`.`SESSION_ID` is not null) and ((sysdate() - `A`.`LAST_REQ_TIME`) < (select `C`.`SESSION_TIMEOUT` from `TB_ASMI_SECURITY_PARAMETERS` `C` where (`A`.`APP_ID` = `C`.`APP_ID`)))) group by `B`.`OS`,`A`.`APP_ID` union all select `A`.`DEVICE_ID` AS `DEVICE_ID`,`A`.`APP_ID` AS `APP_ID`,count(0) AS `COUNT` from `TB_ASTP_LAST_LOGIN` `A` where ((`A`.`DEVICE_ID` in ('WEB','SIMULATOR')) and (`A`.`SESSION_ID` is not null) and ((sysdate() - `A`.`LAST_REQ_TIME`) < (select `C`.`SESSION_TIMEOUT` from `TB_ASMI_SECURITY_PARAMETERS` `C` where (`A`.`APP_ID` = `C`.`APP_ID`)))) group by `A`.`DEVICE_ID`,`A`.`APP_ID`
